name: Yasaka Kurou
source:
A true masterpiece of House Yasaka's craftsmanship, Kurou is presented to House Shiki as their crowning achievement. His emotional detachment is a striking feature, matched only by his uncanny ability to inflict harm and take lives without a flicker of hesitation or remorse, a testament to his innate affinity for violence in all its manifestations. 

Recognizing the immense potential lurking within his singular talents, House Shiki deftly maneuvers to bring him under their wing, eager to cultivate and exploit his gifts for their own ends.

[Edited from [url=https://sekaiproject.com/nie-no-hakoniwa]Sekai Project[/url]]
